title: Attach console, add DXGI InfoQueue + DRED diagnostics, wrap Execute/Present
purpose: Surface runtime failures immediately and capture device-removed breadcrumbs, fixing silent exits.

steps.detail: Allocate console in Debug; redirect stdout/stderr; print init banner.
Enable IDXGIInfoQueue and ID3D12InfoQueue; set BreakOnSeverity for ERROR; dump messages to console on failure.
Check HRESULT from ExecuteCommandLists and Present; on failure, call checkDeviceRemoved(hr) which logs GetDeviceRemovedReason and DRED (ID3D12DeviceRemovedExtendedData2).
Add PIX events around frame begin/end to correlate crashes in captures.

acceptance: Console shows per-frame logs; on failure, prints DXGI/D3D12 errors and DRED summary
PIX captures show markers and failure site
